text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(The Japanese Derby... It's finally here.
But thanks
to you, I feel no hesitation.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, all the work we've put in to get
to this
point has been nothing less than
ideal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I chased after Ines and managed to
catch her
without changing my style.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was also able to greatly improve upon
what I
received from Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We found the perfect balance for her,
one that is
neither too slow nor too fast,
and we stuck with it
all the way through.
choice_data_list: ああ、だいぶよくなったな
うん、だいぶよくなったね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you're looking a lot better.
Yeah, it's gotten a lot better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our strategy is perfect, but that doesn't
mean I'm
not worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if something happens to throw off
her
pace? What if an opponent appears
whose skill
we hadn't anticipated?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And I still can't see a way to my ideal
running
style...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If things aren't in my favor here, then I
may as
well just run however feels
right—no overthinking
it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... If I do that, the others will overtake
me. I've
already been told I can't
brute-force my way
through this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right... I'll need to remain near the front
while
keeping an eye on the runners
behind me. I'm
curious, though...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What is Bright going to do?
